prediction.test: Evaluate summary.json pair_count >= 2 and metrics.rewards_saved_avax > 0. A negative saving contradicts the prediction. Exactly zero or fewer than two pairs is inconclusive. Execution or authentication failure is invalid and yields no scientific insight.

scope: Development-only worked example with its recorded frozen pre-boundary input, released implementation, fitted settings, horizon and seeds.
